en.description: Turn a concept, a finished voiceover script, or a benchmark social video into a 1080×1920 black-and-white hand-drawn whiteboard explainer film. This whiteboard animation maker writes Chinese and English words stroke by stroke or animates flow cards and diagrams, narrates through text-to-speech or a cloned voice, and learns from benchmark Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, or X videos before drafting. Use it for whiteboard animation, hand-drawn explainer videos, doodle videos, concept explainers, what-is-X shorts, vertical explainers, spoken narration, TTS voiceover, and cloned narration for knowledge shorts.
en.summary: Turn a concept, a script, or a benchmark video into a vertical black-and-white hand-drawn whiteboard film, with stroke-by-stroke Chinese and English words, cards and diagrams, and spoken narration.
en.title: Whiteboard Animation Maker: Hand-Drawn Explainer & Doodle Video

zh.description: 用 AI 把一个概念、一份写好的口播稿，或一条要对标的社媒视频，变成 1080×1920 竖屏白板手绘讲解片（白底黑线）。这个白板动画制作工具支持汉字与英文单词逐笔手绘、流程卡片等多种画面，支持口播配音与声音克隆，还能先读取小红书、抖音、TikTok、YouTube、Instagram 或 X 上的对标视频再拆解结构。它也是一款白板动画软件：先看脚本和分镜，满意后一键成片。适用于白板动画、手绘讲解视频、手绘视频、概念科普、什么是 X、口播配音等需求。
zh.summary: 给一个概念、一份口播稿或一条对标视频，产出竖屏白板手绘讲解片：汉字与英文逐笔手绘、卡片关系图、口播配音或克隆配音，本地成片。
